jobs.description_text: We have an opening for a Manager of Product Data & Analytics to lead, mentor, and empower a high-impact team of product analysts. In this role, you and your team won't just report on what is happening in our product—you will help us understand why , and drive the strategic consensus on what we should do about it . About The Role Data can tell us that conversion fell. Your team’s job is to tell us why. Did we impact the product experience? Did the acquisition mix change? Did we bring in lower-intent customers? Did pricing or an onboarding change alter behavior? Did instrumentation change? Is an aggregate metric hiding materially different results across channels, platforms, cohorts, or customer segments? This is a leadership role for a battle-tested product problem solver who leads from the front. You will build a culture of analytical rigor and partner closely with leaders across Product, Design, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and Finance to diagnose performance, evaluate launches, and shape our product roadmap. Our data is accessible through Snowflake and modern AI tooling, including Claude Code. As a manager, you will elevate your team’s execution, ensuring they frame the right questions, interrogate data rigorously, recognize when the obvious answer is wrong, and turn evidence into clear, decisive recommendations.
